data.name: Imteyaz
data.gender_notes: Imteyaz is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Arabic ‘imtī‘āz meaning trust or faith, this name signifies one who has complete faith in God and relies on divine guidance. The name Imteyaz carries the meaning “Trust in God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Imteyaz usually hope their child will grow to embody trust in god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who has faith in God
data.etymology: Imteyaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trust in God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imteyaz total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
